summary: Approximate zodiac circuits and sign residencies for fact-gated Sky Placement cycle lines.
body: The writer may use only the listed circuit and residency language. Moving dates and current-sign ranges remain engine-owned.
note: Owner reviewed against the Swiss Ephemeris verification report on 2026-08-03. Moving dates and current-sign ranges remain engine-owned.

moon.variabilityNote: Reference only. Moon ingress copy remains permanently excluded.

mercury.zodiacCircuit: about 1 year because Mercury stays near the Sun
mercury.typicalSignStay: roughly 2 weeks to 2 months per sign
mercury.variabilityNote: A retrograde in the sign can extend the residency.

venus.typicalSignStay: roughly 3 weeks to 4 months per sign
venus.variabilityNote: A retrograde in the sign can extend the residency.

mars.variabilityNote: A retrograde can extend one sign residency to about 7 months.

pluto.variabilityNote: Pluto has an elliptical orbit, so its time in each sign varies widely. The calculated range for the current sign takes precedence over the average residency.

chiron.variabilityNote: Chiron has an elliptical orbit, so sign residency varies.

north-node.zodiacCircuit: about 18.6 years moving backward through all twelve signs
north-node.variabilityNote: The North and South Nodes move as an opposing sign pair.

south-node.zodiacCircuit: about 18.6 years moving backward through all twelve signs
south-node.variabilityNote: The North and South Nodes move as an opposing sign pair.
